items.title: Huge Unusual Long-Dated Call Options in Oracle Corp - A Covered Call ORCL Play?
items.summary: The unusually large volume in Oracle call options that expire in just over two years may indicate that some institutional investors are taking advantage of ORCL's weak stock price. It could imply a covered call play.

items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Is Exposed To Open Source AI Pricing Risk
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was singled out by investor Steve Eisman in a recent warning about the resilience of Big Tech's AI revenue models. Eisman cautioned that major cloud providers tied to a small group of AI startups could face pressure if open-source AI models trigger a pricing war. He highlighted the concentration of AI related revenue as a possible vulnerability for tech companies relying on a narrow set of high spending customers. The comments add a fresh risk angle for investors tracking...

items.title: 1 Mega-Cap Stock to Research Further and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Megacap stocks dominate their sectors and their actions influence economies worldwide. The flip side though is that their sheer size means they have less room for explosive growth as scale works against them.

items.title: Steve Eisman Just Highlighted a Major Risk for the AI Boom — And It Doesn’t Appear to Bode Well for Nvidia
items.summary: Steve Eisman, the man who called the housing collapse, sees a hidden vulnerability in the AI boom that could ripple far beyond Nvidia and force the biggest names in tech to rethink their spending in ways most investors haven't priced in.
